dossier_meta.statement_text: Can the upper bound on $\operatorname{utw}(\mathcal{G}_{X})$ in Equation 1 be improved? In particular, is $\operatorname{utw}(\mathcal{G}_{X})$ at most a polynomial function of $\operatorname{td}(X)$?
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper's main theorem (Theorem 1) gives an upper bound on the underlying treewidth of $X$-minor-free graph classes in terms of $\operatorname{td}(X)$. This question opens the concluding open-problems section and asks whether that bound can be tightened to a polynomial dependence on $\operatorname{td}(X)$.
